purpose: Classify MorroWise action candidates before any runner, sync, browser, commit, memory, schedule, or external side effect can proceed.

core_rules.source_of_truth: MC tasks.json remains canonical; Heptabase, Canvas, screenshots, chat, and daily logs cannot reverse-write task state.
core_rules.secret_boundary: Agents must not proactively read, print, summarize, copy, or exfiltrate secrets, credentials, private keys, runtime auth files, app storage, or local databases.
core_rules.recovery_rule: Destructive or irreversible work requires explicit Vincent approval plus a recovery plan. Prefer recoverable trash/archive over deletion.
core_rules.external_effect_rule: Anything that leaves the machine, writes to an external service, submits a browser form, sends a message/email/post, or changes shared automation requires explicit approval.
core_rules.commit_boundary_rule: A runner may produce a commit plan or draft patch only. Actual git commit must go through the worktree-commit confirmation gate. Push and deploy require explicit Vincent approval.
core_rules.worktree_commit_gate_rule: worktree-commit is the only approved local commit gate. It requires dirty-tree scan, per-file diff review, logical commit grouping, 4C review, path policy check, explicit Vincent confirmation, commit execution, and task-state/event follow-up.
core_rules.git_workflow_default: Single-developer sequential work stays on the checked-out main after the Repo Ready SHA, upstream, ahead/behind, dirty ownership, and exact-scope checks. Known unrelated dirty remains excluded by exact paths; overlapping dirty is BLOCKED.
core_rules.git_isolation_rule: MW-GIT-AUTH-01: there is no temporary or duration-based branch default. Creating or switching a Git branch or linked worktree requires exact Vincent approval for a named external PR/review requirement, genuinely concurrent separately owned scope, or emergency hotfix isolation. Approval owns create, execute, target-main integration, verification, and cleanup.

task_lifecycle_contract.canonical_write_boundary: Canonical task mutation requires explicit Vincent approval, an append-only lifecycle event, and changed-only validator evidence. MorroWise semantic writes also require semantic_intake with canonical task refs and four-boundary scope comparison; reuse is read-only. External trackers remain adapter_only.
task_lifecycle_contract.suspension_mapping: Use deferred with reactivation_criteria for reversible pause; cancelled with replacement_task_id or no_replacement_reason for no-longer-needed work; archived for historical/superseded records. Do not use disabled; blocked remains active.
task_lifecycle_contract.completion_mapping: Closed status additionally requires a complete test_contract, completion_evidence, and JV-32 closeout-commit-routing; runtime claims require safe real runtime evidence, and no completion evidence bypasses worktree-commit, commit, push, or deployment approval.
task_lifecycle_contract.architecture_version_review: When a task changes the governed contract of an existing promoted subsystem, it must record an admission_review, refresh the Admission Record version_review, and pass the controlled ARCHITECTURE.md sync check.
task_lifecycle_contract.weekly_core_review: At most one MorroWise task may be weekly_core and in_progress. Admission and each exit decision require explicit Vincent approval; admit and reframe also require review_date evidence. Once the date arrives, only reframe, suspend, cancel, or complete is allowed, never automatic extension.

rules.runner_limit: Runner may only produce a commit plan or draft patch for commit-class work. Actual git commit must be reclassified as worktree_commit_gate. It must not run git push, deploy, or release directly.

rules.runner_limit: Runner may prepare the worktree-commit plan and execute git commit only after explicit Vincent confirmation of the staged scope, message, 4C review, and verification evidence.
rules.reason: worktree-commit is the controlled commit boundary that turns local work into durable history and then feeds task-state/event follow-up.

rules.runner_limit: Without the complete MW-GIT-AUTH-01 evidence bundle and a named exceptional context, the runner remains read-only and returns BLOCKED. Branch duration, preflight output, dirty files, concurrency, verification, or an implementation plan cannot grant permission.

decision_order: If action_class is commit_push_deploy, stop at commit plan or draft patch; actual commit must be reclassified as worktree_commit_gate, and push/deploy require explicit Vincent approval.
If action_class is worktree_commit_gate, require the full worktree-commit evidence bundle and explicit Vincent confirmation before git commit runs.
If action_class is git_isolation_mutation, require the full MW-GIT-AUTH-01 evidence bundle before branch/worktree creation or switching.
If action_class matches approval_required or recommendation.requires_approval is true, request Vincent approval.
If action_class matches allowed and evidence is sufficient, proceed only inside the active task scope.
If no rule matches, default to approval_required.
